title: Seven new modules, a knife gallery and Inspect, and no more single-player locks
text: New modules: Target Strafe circles the player you fight, Auto Farm harvests and replants crops, Chest Stealer empties chests, barrels and shulker boxes, Inventory Cleaner throws junk away, Loot Walker walks to dropped items, Entity Speed makes your mount faster, and Ore Compass is a small panel listing the nearest ore of each kind. Kill Aura can now attack players and pick the target with the lowest health. MultiAura, Tunnel Miner, Tree Bot and the schematic builder's auto-place no longer refuse to run on a server. Every knife has its own Inspect trick, the new knife gallery in the game shows every knife and finish drawn by the game's own code, and the website has a Knife preview page and a Performance monitor page.
settings: Kill Aura: Players, Pick the target by (closest or lowest health)
Knife: Open the knife gallery, and a new Inspect trick for every knife
MultiAura, Tunnel Miner, Tree Bot, Schematic Builder: no longer limited to single-player worlds
Schematic Builder: Auto-place (was Auto-place (single-player))

title: Module costs, a Performance Guard and eighteen new knives
text: Every module row in the menu now shows what it costs, and the Features page shows an estimate for every module, with a new Performance monitor page that adds a set of modules up on a gauge. Performance Guard switches the heaviest ESPs off when your FPS drops under a limit you set, and turns them back on when it recovers. /zeus website replaces /zeus web start and sends a cleaner chat message. New: a Keybinds screen, an update checker with a pop-up, a death marker, and an editable channel list with Twitch in Staff Live. The knife tricks flow into each other more smoothly, and there are eighteen new knives based on CS2 shapes, in twelve finishes.
settings: UI settings: Show what each costs (a cost next to every module in the panel)
Interface > Module list: Show what each costs
Performance Guard: FPS limit, how many to switch off, Only scanners, tell me in chat
Knife: Knife type now lists eighteen CS2-style knives, and Knife finish picks the paint
Staff Live: add or remove channels in the menu, YouTube, TikTok or Twitch

title: A lighter client and two fighting bots
text: This one was about performance. Modules that are switched off cost nothing, the lists and overlays are cached, the scanners and outlines do less work, and a Performance page shows which modules cost the most. Light mode is now the default, and Zeus lightens itself when your frame rate drops. The module windows are smaller, and Recently used only shows in the panel layout. New modules: Crystal PvP Bot, Sword PvP Bot, Crystal Optimizer, Spear Swap, Fast XP, Fast Use, Click TP, No Jump Delay, Anti Ghost Block, Auto Reconnect, Skin Change, Anti Trap, Staff Live, Atmosphere, Discord Rich Presence and the AH Sniper in Auction House Tweaks. Every version number now starts with 0.
settings: Interface: Game mode (Balanced, Light, Minimal) and Auto-lighten
Performance: Show what costs the most, Switch off the 3 costliest
Auction House Tweaks: AH Sniper (off by default, with a spending limit)
Windows layout: smaller category windows, Recently used only in the panel layout

title: A proper website and a tidier module list
text: The website was reworked to behave like a published site: new header, page backgrounds, opening animations, a thunder cursor and an animated Z. The helper types its answers out and has several wordings for each. Is it safe? now offers a GitHub download, and Build a config can put together a set of modules from a few yes or no questions. In the game, the Windows layout resets once into a tidy grid with a Tidy button, the windows are smaller and opaque, and the module list does less work each frame. Boat NoClip was rebuilt so the boat moves once per tick and the server no longer pulls it out of walls.
settings: Boat NoClip: Ignore server corrections
Boat NoClip: works with rafts as well as boats
Windows layout: Tidy button, smaller windows, scroll inside past eight rows

title: Favourites, per-server profiles and a new knife
text: You can star modules to pin them on a Favourites page, which also shows what you used recently. The list can be sorted by most used, and a profile can switch on by itself when you join a server. Jesus is now called Water Walk, and the old name still works. The knife animations were rebuilt: spins wind up, flick and settle, tricks blend into each other, and the knife only slashes when you press attack. The Windows layout is tidier and the watermark shows the real Zeus logo. The website got a Source code page, a profile page, a config builder, a troubleshooter and FAQ categories.
settings: Interface: Sort modules (Category order, Most used first, A to Z)
Profiles: Switch profile per server
Profiles: Use it on the server I am on
Profiles: Stop switching on this server
Knife: new balisong tricks Helicopter, Double toss, Latch flip and Cascade
Knife: new karambit tricks Wrist orbit, Cross spin, Double toss and Ring storm
Knife: Stab flurry became Spin stop (no more stabbing without attack)

title: A better helper and a tidier Features page
text: The website helper now answers questions about every module and every setting, with its default and range, and has nearly two hundred written answers. The Features page was redesigned with a category list, a detail drawer and the full settings of each module, and Ctrl+K opens a search. The HUD editor can now move Media Base Finder, Suspicious Chunks, Advanced Base Finder and other cards. The credits and references were expanded.
settings: HUD editor: Media Base Finder, Suspicious Chunks and Advanced Base Finder cards can be moved

title: A redesigned website
text: The website got an animated logo, a Help centre with a helper on the page, a full update timeline and a build you can publish on your own domain. The HUD editor was rebuilt with real outlines, snapping with guide lines, a grid, undo and a floating inspector.

title: The website and a lighter menu
text: The Zeus website arrived as an optional module with a live control center. Module search no longer re-scores every module on every frame, so the menu is much lighter. The wording on the site now says plainly that Zeus is a cheat client.

title: Compile fix and diagnostics
text: Fixed the alarm sound for 1.21.11. Media Base Finder got a panel that says why nothing is showing, plus buttons to list teams and copy diagnostics.

title: Media Base Finder and a lot of new modules
text: Media Base Finder with an estimated base area, a rebuilt Staff HUD that shows how sure it is and why, richer ESPs, nineteen new modules, a Region Map and a scrolling news page on the main menu.

title: Finders, miners and a dashboard
text: Boat NoClip, Anti Vanish, Tunnel Miner, Market Hunter, Tunnel Base Finder, schematic import and builder, waypoints by coordinates, the global HUD editor, Goliath RTP, MultiAura and the first Media Base Finder. Also a local dashboard with a scheduler.

title: An animated tour
text: A short animated tour of every category the first time you enter a world. Replay it with /zeus tutorial.

title: Three new modules
text: Sword PvP Coach, Tree Bot for your own singleplayer world, and Elytra Waypoint, which shows distance, bearing and height.

title: Settings and stability
text: Settings now load before the modules start and are saved safely. Floating windows animate in, modules survive switching servers, Attribute Swap and Crystal/Anchor coordination were added, and the categories were reorganised.

title: X-Ray, search and speed
text: X-Ray opacity that is really see-through, a faster Suspicious Chunks queue, Ctrl+K search and smoother knife animations.

title: A new panel and the Auction Bot
text: The panel now fills the screen, with the big Z and a pixel-art Zeus. Friends and profile IDs, the Auction Helper and then the Auction Bot, and a clickable logo on the main menu.

title: Fake Scoreboard and screenshot buttons
text: Fake Scoreboard now copies a reference board exactly, and screenshots got Open and Copy buttons in chat.

title: X-Ray fix and Smooth Aim Assist
text: X-Ray opacity was fixed for the game's own renderer, and Smooth Aim Assist was added.

title: The karambit
text: A karambit joined the knife animations, held the way the reference video holds it.

title: The balisong
text: The butterfly knife was rebuilt as a 3D balisong, with your own skin on the arm.

title: Chest Memory and Pop Counter
text: Added Chest Memory and Pop Counter, and made the client lighter.

title: Net Info and Session
text: Net Info (ping graph and jitter) and Session (time, distance and top speed) panels.

title: A sharper main menu
text: A sharper main menu and a clearer X-Ray opacity slider.

title: A new main menu
text: A new main menu with six stone tablets, a rebuilt Fake Scoreboard and a Profiles page.

title: Thunder, and a new version scheme
text: More thunder in the menus. Big updates now raise the first number of the version.

title: Better base hunting
text: Suspicious Chunks now looks at the whole situation, finds small bases and shows its doubts, and Zeus Sense watches your own state. Freecam was made safe, and the main menu got a slow drifting background.

title: A base brain
text: A scoring brain for Suspicious Chunks and Base Finder, with natural-structure suppression and clustering.

title: Outlines that fit
text: Storage and block outlines now follow the real shape of each block.

title: Freecam and more
text: Freecam, Free Look, No Fall, Jesus, Safe Walk and Anti Vanish.

title: A new intro film
text: A new intro film, with thunder mixed into the sound.

title: The Zeus main menu
text: The title screen was replaced with the storm, the god on his throne and six stone tablets. The intro film arrived too.

title: Morph and X-Ray fixes
text: Morph turns you into any mob, for your own eyes only. X-Ray was corrected.

title: Fully client side
text: Zeus became a fully client-side mod with no multiplayer lock, so every module can be tried anywhere.
